answer_1.quote: We conduct four sets of experiments... We evaluate model performance from two perspectives: (1) error type detection accuracy, and (2) spoken-to-written conversion quality.
answer_1.outputs: normalized written sentences, error-type labels, and downstream translation outputs

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU, ROUGE-L, and BLEURT to assess semantic fidelity of the generated written text.

answer_4.quote: Two PhD annotators rated outputs for semantic completeness and readability.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated model outputs by judging semantic completeness and readability.
